title: Anchored Regularized Direct Least Squares (ARDLS): Integrating Established Prioritization Operators for Priority Elicitation in the Analytic Hierarchy Process
summary: Pairwise reciprocal matrices are fundamental to the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP),a decision-making model. While the Direct Least Squares (DLS) method provides an intuitive mechanism for deriving priority vectors without complex transformations, it is susceptible to solution non-uniqueness. Under high levels of inconsistency, such as severe cyclic contradictions, the DLS optimization landscape becomes non-convex, yielding multiple distinct global minima.
